observations: Metallic automotive radiator with a dense fin and tube structure.
Two mounting brackets are visible at the top and bottom.
The unit is resting on a wooden surface.
A watermark 'FAMOUS AUTO PARTS' is visible across the center.
The exterior appears dusty or covered in a thin layer of grime.

claims.claim: Barely used, bought new last year. No fault at all, the motor was never opened. Receipt and warranty card available.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Internal corrosion or blockage in the tubes.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the inside of the radiator with the core removed.

risks.risk: Leaks at the mounting brackets or hose fittings.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the bracket joints and the hose connection points.

risks.risk: The unit may be a generic part rather than a specific OEM brand.
risks.proof: A photo of the manufacturer's label or part number sticker.

proof_requests: Photo of the manufacturer's label or part number sticker.
Close-up photo of the mounting brackets and hose fittings.
Photo of the inside of the radiator core.
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a car radiator. It can be priced at its worst-case value (generic, used) until internal condition and part origin are verified.
